2122978130910499250.en_summary: Comparing BigBear AI $BBAI and SoundHound AI $SOUN. BigBear focuses on defense, intelligence, border security and logistics AI, last 12 months revenue $142.1M down 1.5% YoY, net loss $180.2M. SoundHound on commercial side with voice assistants, last 12 months revenue $223.6M +50.7% YoY, net loss $74.2M, no single customer >10%. SoundHound appears ahead on growth into 2027.
2122978130910499250.zh_summary: 比較 BigBear AI $BBAI 和 SoundHound AI $SOUN。BigBear 專注於國防、情報、邊境安全和物流 AI，過去 12 個月收入 1.421 億美元同比下降 1.5%，淨虧損 1.802 億美元。SoundHound 在商業方面有語音助手，過去 12 個月收入 2.236 億美元同比增長 50.7%，淨虧損 7420 萬美元，無單一客戶超過 10%。SoundHound 在進入 2027 年的增長方面似乎領先。
